## MarketParams.from() method

Returns market params from a params object or hydrated market.

Use at boundaries that accept either a standalone market config or a full market object. Existing `MarketParams` instances are returned as-is.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static from(market: MarketInput): MarketParams;
```

## Example


```ts
import { MarketParams } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";

const params = MarketParams.from({
  chainId: 8453,
  midnight: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001000",
  loanToken: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000006000",
  collateralParams: [
    {
      token: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000007000",
      lltv: 770000000000000000n,
      liquidationCursor: 250000000000000000n,
      oracle: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000008000",
    },
  ],
  maturity: 54_000n,
  rcfThreshold: 0n,
  enterGate: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
  liquidatorGate: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
});
console.log(params.loanToken);
```
